questions.questionHtml:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

3 and 4
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Here interchanging the given two numbers to find which equation will be not correct.

Given: 3 and 4

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 3 + 5 × 4 – 6 ÷ 2 = 16 

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 4 + 5 × 3 – 6 ÷ 2 = 16 

⇒ 4 + 5 × 3 - 3 = 16

⇒ 4 + 15 - 3 = 16

⇒ 19 - 3 = 16

⇒ 16 = 16

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 4 × 6 – 3 + 9 ÷ 1 = 25 

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 3 × 6 – 4 + 9 ÷ 1 = 25 

⇒ 3 × 6 – 4 + 9 = 25

⇒ 18 - 4 + 9 = 25

⇒ 27 - 4 = 25

⇒ 23 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 3 × 7 – 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 27 

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 4 × 7 – 8 ÷ 2 + 3 = 27 

⇒ 4 × 7 - 4 + 3 = 27

⇒ 28 - 4 + 3 = 27

⇒ 31 - 4 = 27

⇒ 27 = 27

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 – 8 = 1 

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 9 × 4 ÷ 6 + 3 – 8 = 1 

⇒ 9 × 0.66 + 3 - 8 = 1

⇒ 6 + 3 - 8 = 1

⇒ 9 - 8 = 1

⇒ 1 = 1

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

(50 ÷ 3) × 15 + 25 − 10 = 25
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

In this question, two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct.

Given: (50 ÷ 3) × 15 + 25 − 10 = 25

Option 1) ÷ and -

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 - 3) × 15 + 25 ÷ 10 = 25

⇒ 47 × 15 + 25 ÷ 10 = 25

⇒ 47 × 15 + 2.5 = 25

⇒ 705 + 2.5 = 25

⇒ 707.5 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 ÷ 3) + 15 × 25 − 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 + 15 × 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 + 375 - 10 = 25

⇒ 391.66 - 10 = 25

⇒ 381.66 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ÷ and × 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 × 3) ÷ 15 + 25 − 10 = 25

⇒ 150 ÷ 15 + 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 10 + 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 35 - 10 = 25

⇒ 25 = 25

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) + and − 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 ÷ 3) × 15 - 25 + 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 * 15 - 25 + 10 = 25

​⇒ 249.9 - 25 + 10 = 25

​⇒ 259.9 - 25 = 25

​⇒ 234.9 ≠ 25

​⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: How many fundamental duties are provided in the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHtml: How many fundamental duties are provided in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 11.

Key Points

  • The original constitution contained only the fundamental rights and not the fundamental duties.
  • They incorporated the duties of the State in the Constitution in the form of Directive Principles of State Polity.
  • In 1976 Sardar Swarna Singh committee to make recommendations about fundamental duties
  • The 42nd Constitution amendment act in 1976 added a new part IVA 
  • It consists of only one article that is article 51A
  • Swarna Singh suggested 8 fundamental duties in the constitution, 42nd Constitution amendment act added 10 duties
  • In 2002, one more Fundamental Duty was added.
  • So, at present there are total of 11 Fundamental Duties are included in the Indian Constitution.

Additional Information

  • The Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution are inspired by the Constitution of the erstwhile USSR.
  • None of the Constitutions of major democratic countries like the USA, Canada, France, Germany, Australia, and so on specifically contain a list of duties of citizens.
  • Japanese Constitution is, perhaps, the only democratic Constitution in the world that contains a list of duties of citizens.
  • Fundamental duties are confined to citizens only and do not extend to foreigners.
  • Fundamental duties are non-justiceable.

questions.solution: Loo. Loo is a local wind that blows in some regions of India and Pakistan, particularly in the months of May and June. questions.question: Mr. X has a monthly income of $26,500 and his monthly expenditure is $20,500. The next year, his salary is increased by 12% and expenditure is increased by 6%. His savings increase by how much percent?

questions.solution:
Original saving = $6,000

New income = $26,500 + 12% of $26,500 ⇒ $29,680

New expenditure = $20,500 + 6% of $20,500 ⇒ $21,730

New saving = $(29,680 – $21,730) ⇒ $7950 

Change in saving =  $(7950 – 6,000) = $1,950

Percentage of increase in his saving = (1950/6,000) × 100 ⇒ 32.5%

    • Idiosyncrasy: A mode of behaviour or way of thought peculiar to an individual. (किसी व्यक्ति के लिए विशिष्ट व्यवहार या विचार का तरीका)
  • From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of 'Valour' is 'Cowardice'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Key Points

    • Donkey’s years: A very long time.
    • Duck in the thunderstorm: Looking hopelessly sad and dejected.
    • Die in harness: To die while still working or on duty or before retirement.

  • So, as per the meaning of the given idioms "Donkey’s years" is the most appropriate option.

Hinglish

  • The idiomatic expression "donkey's years" is used in English to denote a very long time.
  • The phrase originates from the idea that donkeys live a long time, and also from rhyming slang where "years" rhymes with "donkey ears."
  • In Hindi, the closest expression may be "बहुत समय", meaning a lot of time, or "लंबे समय तक", meaning for a long time.
    • Example: "I haven't seen you in donkey's years!"
    • This means I haven't seen you for a very long time.
  • In Hindi, you might express it like: "मुझे लगता है कि मैंने तुम्हें बहुत समय से नहीं देखा है!"
    • This means I feel I haven't seen you for a very long time.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Between

Key Points

  • Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
    • About: On the subject of, or connected with. (के विषय में, या उससे जुड़ा हुआ)
    • Beside: At the side of; next to, or in addition to. (के पक्ष में; इसके आगे या इसके अतिरिक्त)
    • Between: In or along the space separating two objects or regions. (दो वस्तुओं या क्षेत्रों को अलग करने वाली जगह में या साथ में)
    • Among: In the middle of or surrounded by other things. (बीच में या अन्य चीजों से घिरा हुआ)
  • The implied meaning of the sentence is: During September and November is the most fantastic time for visitors to visit Tawang.
  • So, as per the meaning of the given words "between" is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
